Cotton, ribbed jersey, tissue, kraft paper, pale timber, matte cocoa metal and frosted acrylic. Connected sunny boutique and organised human-scale stockroom. Soft garment foreground, structured operational objects behind. Gentle humour, capable small business. Landscape 1536x1024, safe central composition and breathing room. No generated UI, charts, readable letters, QR codes, numbers, logos or watermarks. Blank tags can be rectangular pieces of card. No neon, grim warehouses, enterprise control rooms or clinical surfaces. This is conceptual artwork, not a photograph of real inventory or proof of a shipped interface.
SCENE: Late afternoon at the Coco boutique packaging bench. One kraft parcel neatly closed with coral ribbon and blank label, peach tissue peeking from an open spare box, organised garment shelves behind. Coco mascot rests quietly at the edge of the room, small and content, never a worker cartoon. No screen or UI, no implied carrier integration, golden low sunlight and long soft shadows. The work is done.
The reference is the existing Coco mascot identity ONLY. Preserve the cream fluffy llama, expressive warm brown eyes, gentle smile, long ears with pink inner ears, coral knitted shawl/scarf with a small flower brooch, and small brown hooves. Keep her naturally llama-shaped, tasteful and friendly. No redesign, no human costume, no warehouse uniform. She is a small supporting presence. Do not copy the isolated black/transparent background, shopping bag or cardigan unless scene requests it.
